answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while signed messages expose coordinated equivocation. If k identities repeat or reinforce conflicting votes, correlated fault evidence triggers penalties proportional to O(k^2), rather than independent fines. Detecting a managed sybil swarm also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation, making identity splitting uneconomic; kernel, orchard, and tundra domains follow the same rule.
